AC8.scope: Real revoked-membership error, retained reason/stale acknowledgment, phone keyboard entry and explicit retry. Browser success is confirmed by relevant SQL projections, not HTTPok. Full role/tenant/RPC/DML matrix is cross-level; no blanket browser coverage claim.

limitations: Bounded named-test assertion assessment, not a fourth broad code review. Review cap remains 3/3.
No runtime, browser, DB, CI, remote or legacy service accessed; native prior execution is qualified by actual passed bodies, report hashes and unchanged sources.
Flytta/Omfordela UI suggestion selection is not browser-executed; actual action/checked commit coverage is INT-012. No complete browser AC matrix is claimed.
Two SSR component cases check static structure only; mocked/projected read-model tests do not earn physical DB, native interaction or layout coverage.
HTTP response.ok in lost-response forwarding is transport-only. Durable outcome/history/notification projections and explicit saved UI assertions supply the stated success evidence.
